definition: The absolute net change over period bars divided by the sum of the absolute bar-to-bar changes.
boundaries: Kaufman's ratio as KAMA uses it. It sees trend and is blind to mean reversion; missing while the window holds no movement at all.
recognition: Near 1 when every bar moved one way, near 0 when the moves cancel out.

class_meanings.index_cfd: A return across a session close, a weekend or a contract roll is a gap, not a bar's move; bind the statistic to bars inside one session or a back-adjusted series, or it reads the gap.
